dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(COUNTROWS(CALCULATETABLE(VALUES('HR KPI'[KPI Code]), 'HR KPI'[Kind] = "kpi", 'HR KPI'[Needs Pay] = 1)) = 5 && COUNTROWS(FILTER(CALCULATETABLE(VALUES('HR KPI'[KPI Code]), 'HR KPI'[Kind] = "kpi", 'HR KPI'[Needs Pay] = 1), CALCULATE(NOT (IF([HR Can See Pay] = 0, ISBLANK([HR KPI Target]) && ISBLANK([HR KPI Watch]) && ISBLANK([HR KPI Fixed Target]) && ISBLANK([HR KPI Fixed Watch]) && ISBLANK([HR KPI Variance]) && EXACT([HR KPI Target Text], "Requires pay access") && EXACT([HR KPI Watch Text], "Requires pay access") && EXACT([HR KPI Variance Text], "Requires pay access") && EXACT([HR KPI Pay Notice], "Requires pay access"), NOT EXACT([HR KPI Target Text], "Requires pay access") && NOT EXACT([HR KPI Watch Text], "Requires pay access") && NOT EXACT([HR KPI Variance Text], "Requires pay access") && ISBLANK([HR KPI Pay Notice]) && ROUND([HR KPI Target] - [HR KPI Fixed Target], 6) = 0 && ROUND([HR KPI Watch] - [HR KPI Fixed Watch], 6) = 0)), 'Date'[Year Month] = 202609))) = 0))

name: kpi_pay_notice_blank_for_non_pay_kpi
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(ISBLANK(CALCULATE([HR KPI Pay Notice], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_HEADCOUNT")) && ISBLANK([HR KPI Pay Notice]) && ISBLANK(CALCULATE([HR KPI Pay Notice], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_TURNOVER"))))

name: variance_is_actual_minus_target_2026_09
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(COUNTROWS(FILTER(CALCULATETABLE(VALUES('HR KPI'[KPI Code]), 'HR KPI'[Kind] = "kpi"), CALCULATE(NOT (VAR a = [HR KPI Actual] VAR t = [HR KPI Target] VAR v = [HR KPI Variance] VAR np = SELECTEDVALUE('HR KPI'[Needs Pay]) = 1 && [HR Can See Pay] = 0 RETURN IF(np || ISBLANK(a) || ISBLANK(t), ISBLANK(v), ROUND(v - (a - t), 6) = 0)), 'Date'[Year Month] = 202609))) = 0))

name: variance_text_follows_value_format_2026_09
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(COUNTROWS(FILTER(CALCULATETABLE(VALUES('HR KPI'[KPI Code]), 'HR KPI'[Kind] = "kpi"), CALCULATE(NOT (VAR v = [HR KPI Variance] VAR f = SELECTEDVALUE('HR KPI'[Value Format]) VAR x = [HR KPI Variance Text] VAR np = SELECTEDVALUE('HR KPI'[Needs Pay]) = 1 && [HR Can See Pay] = 0 RETURN EXACT(x, IF(np, "Requires pay access", IF(ISBLANK(v), UNICHAR(8211), SWITCH(f, "pct", FORMAT(v, "+0.0%;-0.0%;0.0%"), "sar", FORMAT(v, "+#,0;-#,0;0"), "days", FORMAT(v, "+#,0.0;-#,0.0;0.0"), IF(CALCULATE([HR KPI Is Additive]) = 1, FORMAT(v, "+#,0;-#,0;0"), FORMAT(v, "+#,0.00;-#,0.00;0.00"))))))), 'Date'[Year Month] = 202609))) = 0))

name: variance_blank_without_one_kpi
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(ISBLANK(CALCULATE([HR KPI Variance], 'Date'[Year Month] = 202609)) && ISBLANK(CALCULATE([HR KPI Variance Text], 'Date'[Year Month] = 202609))))

name: variance_by_kpi_row_no_guard_2026_09
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(NOT CONTAINSSTRING(CALCULATE(CONCATENATEX(VALUES('HR KPI'[KPI Code]), [HR KPI Variance] & [HR KPI Variance Text] & [HR KPI Watch Text] & [HR KPI Pay Notice] & ""), 'Date'[Year Month] = 202609), "can't be analysed")))

name: watch_text_follows_value_format_2026_09
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(COUNTROWS(FILTER(CALCULATETABLE(VALUES('HR KPI'[KPI Code]), 'HR KPI'[Kind] = "kpi"), CALCULATE(NOT (VAR w = [HR KPI Watch] VAR f = SELECTEDVALUE('HR KPI'[Value Format]) VAR x = [HR KPI Watch Text] VAR np = SELECTEDVALUE('HR KPI'[Needs Pay]) = 1 && [HR Can See Pay] = 0 RETURN EXACT(x, IF(np, "Requires pay access", IF(ISBLANK(w), "Not set", SWITCH(f, "pct", FORMAT(w, "0.0%"), "sar", FORMAT(w, "#,0"), "days", FORMAT(w, "#,0.0"), IF(CALCULATE([HR KPI Is Additive]) = 1, FORMAT(w, "#,0"), FORMAT(w, "#,0.00"))) & IF([HR KPI Is Placeholder] = 1, " (placeholder)", ""))))), 'Date'[Year Month] = 202609))) = 0))

name: watch_text_not_set_2025
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(EXACT(CALCULATE([HR KPI Watch Text], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_TURNOVER", 'Date'[Year] = 2025), "Not set")))

name: ytd_flow_kpi_is_jan_to_month_2026_09
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", VAR aY = CALCULATE([HR KPI Actual], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_TURNOVER", 'Date'[Year Month] = 202609, 'Time Calculation'[Time Calculation] = "YTD") VAR aR = CALCULATE([HR KPI Actual], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_TURNOVER", 'Date'[Year Month] >= 202601, 'Date'[Year Month] <= 202609) VAR aSep = CALCULATE([HR KPI Actual], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_TURNOVER", 'Date'[Year Month] = 202609) VAR tY = CALCULATE([HR KPI Target], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_TURNOVER", 'Date'[Year Month] = 202609, 'Time Calculation'[Time Calculation] = "YTD") VAR tR = CALCULATE([HR KPI Target], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_TURNOVER", 'Date'[Year Month] >= 202601, 'Date'[Year Month] <= 202609) VAR tS = CALCULATE([HR KPI Target], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_TURNOVER", 'Date'[Year Month] = 202609) VAR sY = CALCULATE([HR KPI Status], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_TURNOVER", 'Date'[Year Month] = 202609, 'Time Calculation'[Time Calculation] = "YTD") VAR sR = CALCULATE([HR KPI Status], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_TURNOVER", 'Date'[Year Month] >= 202601, 'Date'[Year Month] <= 202609) RETURN INT(NOT ISBLANK(aY) && ROUND(aY - aR, 9) = 0 && aY > aSep && ROUND(tY - tR, 9) = 0 && IF(ISBLANK(tS), ISBLANK(tY), ROUND(tY - 9 * tS, 9) = 0) && sY = sR))

name: ytd_snapshot_kpi_is_month_end_2026_09
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", VAR aY = CALCULATE([HR KPI Actual], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_HEADCOUNT", 'Date'[Year Month] = 202609, 'Time Calculation'[Time Calculation] = "YTD") VAR aSep = CALCULATE([HR KPI Actual], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_HEADCOUNT", 'Date'[Year Month] = 202609) VAR tY = CALCULATE([HR KPI Target], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_HEADCOUNT", 'Date'[Year Month] = 202609, 'Time Calculation'[Time Calculation] = "YTD") VAR tR = CALCULATE([HR KPI Target], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_HEADCOUNT", 'Date'[Year Month] >= 202601, 'Date'[Year Month] <= 202609) VAR sY = CALCULATE([HR KPI Status], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_HEADCOUNT", 'Date'[Year Month] = 202609, 'Time Calculation'[Time Calculation] = "YTD") VAR sR = CALCULATE([HR KPI Status], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_HEADCOUNT", 'Date'[Year Month] >= 202601, 'Date'[Year Month] <= 202609) RETURN INT(NOT ISBLANK(aY) && aY = aSep && ROUND(tY - tR, 9) = 0 && sY = sR))
